title: Prairie Dogs Can Describe the Shirt You're Wearing

scenes.text: A prairie dog can warn its whole town about you, and describe what you're wearing.
Biologist Con Slobodchikoff has studied their alarm calls for decades.
They have different calls for coyotes, dogs, hawks and humans.
In one test, the same person walked through a colony wearing different colored shirts.
The calls kept the person's size and shape, but the color part changed with the shirt.
A squeak you'd never notice carries a full description of you.

description:
Prairie dogs have a distinct alarm call for humans, and it can describe a person's size, shape and even shirt color.
Research by Con Slobodchikoff tested the same person in different colored shirts.
What would a prairie dog say about you?
first_comment: What would a prairie dog say about what you're wearing today?
